question: Does oWALNUTS's installed diagonal inverse mass (Stan's regularisation, (n/(n+5)) var + 1e-3 * 5/(n+5)) over-state the posterior variance on a subset of coordinates where nutpie's does not, on the house 17; and does either of two research-only regularisations that lower Stan's absolute 1e-3 anchor only where a window variance is below it meet the frozen promotion rule against the default?
output: Descriptive ratios and a verdict per candidate against the frozen rule. No default flip in this study whatever the outcome.

commit.note: main 64c9c0d6 (WP80 merged) plus the research-only variants DiagonalMetricRegularization::StanLowAnchor and StanCoordinateCap; the default path is unchanged (kernel fingerprints pass with the research feature off and on)

seeds_note: fresh: git grep -w finds none of 810101-810103 or 810111-810120 before the freeze

arms.owalnuts: the shipped default (Sampler::new(), Adaptation::default(): DiagonalMetricRegularization::Stan), v7 cell; the decision baseline
arms.owalnuts-lowanchor: Adaptation::Custom(WarmupConfig::new(0.8).with_warmup_exhaustion_rule(DEFAULT_WARMUP_EXHAUSTION).with_metric_regularization(StanLowAnchor)): (n/(n+5)) var_i + (5/(n+5)) min(1e-3, v_min), v_min the smallest finite positive window variance; a coordinate with non-positive window variance keeps 1e-3
arms.owalnuts-coordcap: the same with StanCoordinateCap: (n/(n+5)) var_i + (5/(n+5)) min(1e-3, var_i); a coordinate with non-positive window variance keeps 1e-3
arms.nutpie: nutpie 0.16.8 at defaults (descriptive only), store_mass_matrix and store_unconstrained (storage flags), WP80's cell code
arms.shared: 4 chains x 1,000 warmup / 1,000 retained; oWALNUTS through ReplicatedStanTarget with 4 replicas (replicated dispatch, as WP64/WP72/WP80); v7 gates and cell code; both candidate rules are identical to Stan for any window whose variances are all >= 1e-3

run_order: models in v7's house order; arms owalnuts, owalnuts-lowanchor, owalnuts-coordcap, nutpie; seeds ascending; one child per cell; strictly sequential; then the funnel (arm-major, seeds ascending); then refscales; no reruns

funnel.design: v7's funnel binary with the arm switch: Neal's 10-D funnel, starts omega in {-3,-1,1,3}, 4 x 2,000 warmup / 20,000 retained, P(omega < -5)

descriptive.ratio: per cell and unconstrained coordinate i: median over chains of installed inverse mass (oWALNUTS 1/mass_diagonal, K = 0.5 sum p^2/M_i; nutpie mass_matrix_inv at the last retained draw) divided by the variance of that cell's retained unconstrained draws pooled over chains (ddof 1); also divided by the posteriordb reference variance on the unconstrained scale (reference draws mapped with BridgeStan param_unconstrain; models whose reference lacks a parameter are skipped). Per model: per coordinate the median over seeds; reported: min, max, number of coordinates outside the band, SD of log ratio; adapted step (median over chains, then seeds)

rule.R1: cells passing the v7 gates (51 = 17 x 3) not lower than the default on the same seeds
rule.R2: WP72-form (c) headline: per model the median over seeds of the paired ratio candidate / default of min bulk ESS per gradient (seeds with both cells status ok; a model enters with >= ceil(5n/6) = 3 of 3), geomean over models >= 1.10
rule.R3: median over models of the per-model ratio >= 1.05
rule.R5: no new divergences: no (model, seed) where the candidate has retained divergences and the default has none
rule.R6: funnel: the mean of the ten per-seed P(omega < -5) estimates within 1 s.e. (sd over seeds / sqrt(10)) of 0.0478
rule.R7: kernel fingerprint test (tests/kernel_fingerprint.rs) passing with the research flags off, on the box at the commit under test (artifacts/fingerprint-test.txt); also run with the feature on (reported)
rule.verdict: a candidate meets the rule only if R1-R7 all hold; meeting it would make it eligible for a separate default-flip decision, not flip anything here

D1.text: on each WP80 step-gap model (sblrc, hmm_drive_0, eight_schools_centered, diamonds) oWALNUTS's default has >= 1 coordinate with own-draw ratio outside [0.5, 2] and nutpie has none

D1b.source: this study (WP41: sblrc 9.8-11.9x on five coordinates, diamonds up to 4.27x)
D1b.text: oWALNUTS's default has >= 5 coordinates outside the band on sblrc and >= 1 on diamonds; on hmm_drive_0 and eight_schools_centered every coordinate is inside the band (their step gap is not the regularisation)

predictions.C1: both candidates fail R2 (geomean >= 1.10): they change only models with window variances below 1e-3; WP41's sblrc gain of ~2x is worth ~1.04 over 17 models
predictions.C2: both candidates fail R3 (median over models >= 1.05): most models are unchanged or within noise

C4.text: each candidate is bit-identical to the default (status, gradients_total, min bulk ESS) on >= 24 of 51 cells

predictions.C5: R1, R5 and R6 hold for both candidates
predictions.expectation: neither candidate meets the rule; verdict 'not supported, keep Stan'

platform.machine: AWS EC2 c7a.4xlarge (AMD EPYC 9R14), Ubuntu 24.04, lane 1: taskset -c 0-3, RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, files under ~/lanes/diagonal_metric_shrinkage_v1/
platform.wall_label_note: Linux, core-pinned to 4 dedicated cores (taskset -c 0-3) on a shared box with other pinned lanes active (shared L3 and memory bandwidth): walls are 'pinned, co-tenanted'. Pass counts, gradient counts and ESS per gradient are unaffected by co-tenancy. No statistic of this study uses a wall.
platform.software: lane venv on Python 3.12.3: nutpie 0.16.8, bridgestan 2.9.0, arviz 0.23.4, numpy 2.4.6, scipy 1.17.1, xarray 2026.9.0, posteriordb 0.2.0, pandas 3.1.0, cmdstanpy 1.3.0; oWALNUTS harness built with Rust 1.88.0 on the box (as WP64/WP72), --release --locked -j4

rules: Freeze PREREGISTRATION.md and protocol.json in a commit before the first evidence cell. Sequential cells; failures, crashes and timeouts are results; no reruns, no tuning after results. A driver crash may be relaunched; only an interrupted cell without a completed artifact may be rerun from scratch with the same seed, recorded in AMENDMENTS.md. Raw draws and telemetry are checksummed and not committed.
